macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white dorsal mane/crest; distinct white chevron markings on the lower limbs; white spotting visible on the malar region and bridge of the nose.
